text_en: On the third new moon after the Israelites had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that very day, they came into the wilderness of Sinai.
text_cn: 以色列子民离开埃及国后，第三个月初一那一天，到了西乃旷野。

text_en: They had journeyed from Rephidim, entered the wilderness of Sinai, and camped in the wilderness; Israel camped there in front of the mountain.
text_cn: 他们从勒非丁起程，来到西乃旷野，就在旷野中安了营；以色列人在那座山前安了营。

text_en: Then Moses went up to God; the Lord called to him from the mountain, saying, “Thus you shall say to the house of Jacob, and tell the Israelites:
text_cn: 梅瑟上到天主前，上主从山上召唤他说：“你要这样告诉雅各伯家，训示以色列子民说：

text_en: You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings and brought you to myself.
text_cn: 你们亲自见了我怎样对待了埃及人，怎样好似鹰将你们背在翅膀上，将你们带出来归属我。

text_en: Now therefore, if you obey my voice and keep my covenant, you shall be my treasured possession out of all the peoples. Indeed, the whole earth is mine,
text_cn: 现在你们若真听我的话，遵守我的盟约，你们在万民中将成为我的特殊产业。的确，普世全属于我，

text_en: but you shall be for me a priestly kingdom and a holy nation. These are the words that you shall speak to the Israelites. ”
text_cn: 但你们为我应成为司祭的国家，圣洁的国民。你应将这些话训示以色列子民。”

text_en: So Moses came, summoned the elders of the people, and set before them all these words that the Lord had commanded him.
text_cn: 梅瑟就去召集百姓的长老，将上主吩咐他的那一切话，都在他们前说明了。

text_en: The people all answered as one: “Everything that the Lord has spoken we will do. ” Moses reported the words of the people to the Lord .
text_cn: 众百姓一致回答说：“凡上主所吩咐的，我们全要作。”梅瑟遂将百姓的答复转达于上主。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “I am going to come to you in a dense cloud, in order that the people may hear when I speak with you and so trust you ever after. ” When Moses had told the words of the people to the Lord ,
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“我要在浓云中降到你前，叫百姓听见我与你谈话，使他们永远信服你。”梅瑟遂向上主呈报了百姓的答复。

text_en: the Lord said to Moses: “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. Have them wash their clothes
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“你到百姓那里，叫他们今天明天圣洁自己，洗净自己的衣服。

text_en: and prepare for the third day, because on the third day the Lord will come down upon Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
text_cn: 第三天都应准备妥当，因为第三天，上主要在百姓观望之下降到西乃山上。

text_en: You shall set limits for the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful not to go up the mountain or to touch the edge of it. Any who touch the mountain shall be put to death.
text_cn: 你要给百姓在山周围划定界限说：应小心，不可上山，也不可触摸山脚；凡触摸那山的，应处死刑。

text_en: No hand shall touch them, but they shall be stoned or shot with arrows; whether animal or human being, they shall not live. ’ When the trumpet sounds a long blast, they may go up on the mountain. ”
text_cn: 谁也不可用手触摸那人，而应用石头砸死或用箭射死；不论是兽是人，都不得生存；号角响起的时候，他们才可上山。”

text_en: So Moses went down from the mountain to the people. He consecrated the people, and they washed their clothes.
text_cn: 梅瑟下山来到百姓那里，叫他们圣洁自己，洗净自己的衣服。

text_en: And he said to the people, “Prepare for the third day; do not go near a woman. ”
text_cn: 他向百姓说：“到第三天应准备妥当，不可接近女人。”

text_en: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, as well as a thick cloud on the mountain, and a blast of a trumpet so loud that all the people who were in the camp trembled.
text_cn: 到了第三天早晨，山上雷电交作，浓云密布，角声齐鸣，此时在营中的百姓都战战兢兢。

text_en: Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God. They took their stand at the foot of the mountain.
text_cn: 梅瑟叫百姓从营中出来迎接天主，他们都站在山下。

text_en: Now Mount Sinai was wrapped in smoke, because the Lord had descended upon it in fire; the smoke went up like the smoke of a kiln, while the whole mountain shook violently.
text_cn: 此时西乃全山冒烟，因为上主在火中降到山上；冒出的烟像火窑的烟，全山猛烈震动。

text_en: As the blast of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses would speak and God would answer him in thunder.
text_cn: 角声越响越高；梅瑟遂开始说话，天主藉雷霆答复他。

text_en: When the Lord descended upon Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain, the Lord summoned Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.
text_cn: 上主降到西乃山顶上，召梅瑟上到山顶；梅瑟就上去了。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to the Lord to look; otherwise many of them will perish.
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“下去通告百姓：不可闯到上主面前观看，免得许多人死亡。

text_en: Even the priests who approach the Lord must consecrate themselves or the Lord will break out against them. ”
text_cn: 连那些接近上主的司祭们，也应圣洁自己，免得上主击杀他们。”

text_en: Moses said to the Lord , “The people are not permitted to come up to Mount Sinai; for you yourself warned us, saying, ‘Set limits around the mountain and keep it holy. ’”
text_cn: 梅瑟答复上主说：“百姓不能上西乃山，因你自己曾通告我们说：要在山的四周划定界限，也宣布这山是不可侵犯的。”

text_en: The Lord said to him, “Go down, and come up bringing Aaron with you; but do not let either the priests or the people break through to come up to the Lord ; otherwise he will break out against them. ”
text_cn: 上主向他说：“下去，你同亚郎一起上来，但司祭和百姓不可闯到上主前，免得我击杀他们。”

text_en: So Moses went down to the people and told them.
text_cn: 梅瑟便下到百姓那里，通知了他们。
